steps.title: Spin down bead plates
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the bead‑beater plates at 1000 × g for 1 min (temperature not specified) to pull beads into the wells.

steps.title: Aliquot stool into beads plate
steps.instruction: Add approximately 200 mg stool to each well of a 96‑well deep‑well plate pre‑filled with 0.1 mm ceramic beads (Omni International catalog #27‑6007); ensure stool is pushed to the bottom to prevent lysis‑buffer overflow.

steps.title: Add lysis buffer
steps.instruction: Dispense 750 µL of lysis buffer (6 M urea, 50 mM Tris‑Base, 5 % SDS, pH 8.1) to each well using a multichannel pipette.

steps.title: Seal and bead beat
steps.instruction: Seal the plate with the provided top, place it in the 96‑well bead beater and run at 20 Hz for 10 min.

steps.title: Centrifuge post‑bead beat
steps.instruction: Spin the sealed plate at 3000 × g for 10 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Transfer homogenate to new plate
steps.instruction: Observe homogenization; aliquot 500 µL of each homogenized sample into a new Waters 2 mL deep‑well plate (catalog #186002482), spin 10 min at 3000 × g and collect the supernatant as the sample stock.

steps.title: Cool and alkylate with IAA
steps.instruction: Remove plates, let cool to room temperature, spin 30 s at 1000 × g (temperature not specified), remove the sealing mat, add 30 µL of 500 mM iodoacetamide (Merck MilliporeSigma catalog #I1149) to each well, and incubate in total darkness for 1 h.

steps.title: Load samples onto S‑trap
steps.instruction: Add the IAA mixture to the Protifi S‑trap 96‑well plate placed on a waste plate (Abgene 1.2 mL plate, catalog #AB0787); apply positive pressure at 6 psi (main dial) and 15 psi (secondary dial) to push samples through, scraping clogs gently with a pipette tip if needed.

steps.title: Wash S‑trap with binding buffer
steps.instruction: Wash each well five times with 500 µL fresh Protifi Binding Buffer, emptying the waste plate as required; after washing, place the S‑trap on a fresh 1.2 mL Thermo plate.

steps.title: Add benzonase and incubate
steps.instruction: Add 3 µL benzonase (Merck Millipore catalog #101656) to each well and incubate at 37 °C for 10 min.

steps.title: Digest and sequential peptide elution
steps.instruction: Elute digested peptides using the positive‑pressure processor, then perform three washes:

substeps.instruction: Add 100 µL TEAB, elute with pressure.
Collect the combined eluate (~425 µL) and dry in a SpeedVac.

steps.title: Resuspend dried peptides in FA
steps.instruction: Resuspend the dried peptide pellet in 150 µL 0.2 % FA, pipette up/down and wash well walls, then spin at 3000 × g for 10 min; transfer the clear supernatant to a fresh plate, avoiding any debris.

steps.title: Peptide cleanup on Bravo
steps.instruction: Using the Assaymap Bravo Peptide Cleanup V2 app, process the samples on RPS or C18 tips (≈100 µg capacity); after cleanup, dry the samples again in a SpeedVac.

steps.title: Final peptide resuspension
steps.instruction: Resuspend the dried peptides in 30 µL 0.2 % FA.

steps.title: Adjust concentration if unlabeled
steps.instruction: If the samples will not be TMT‑labeled, measure peptide concentration with a Nanodrop and adjust to 0.5–1 µg µL⁻¹ for nano‑flow LC MS.

steps.title: Prepare TMT‑labeling aliquots
steps.instruction: From the cleanup step, record concentration (expect >40 µg per well). Resuspend each well to 0.5 µg µL⁻¹, transfer 20 µg peptide to a new plate, dry both plates, and store the original plate at –20 °C.

steps.title: Resuspend for TMT reaction
steps.instruction: Resuspend the 20 µg peptide plate in 50 µL 50 mM Na‑HEPES, pH 8.5 (catalog #H7006‑100G) and transfer to a fresh Eppendorf 96‑well LoBind plate (catalog #30129512).

steps.title: Prepare TMT reagents
steps.instruction: Remove the TMT kit from the –80 °C freezer, let warm to room temperature for 10 min (do not open lids), spin each reagent tube, add 20 µL ACN to each tube (adjust volume per column as needed), vortex, incubate 5 min, vortex 2.5 min, spin, and aliquot the dissolved reagents into the first row of a fresh 96‑well plate.

steps.title: Add TMT to samples
steps.instruction: Using a multichannel pipette, add 20 µL of the appropriate TMT reagent to each well, loosely cover with an Axygen silicone mat (catalog #14‑222‑024), and incubate for 1 h at room temperature.

steps.title: Quench labeling reaction
steps.instruction: Add 10 µL of 5 % hydroxylamine in 50 mM HEPES‑Na to each well and incubate 15 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Acidify peptide solutions
steps.instruction: Add enough 25 % FA to each well (up to ~15 µL) to bring the pH to ~2; perform this step on a dummy well containing no peptides.

steps.title: Final resuspension and QC
steps.instruction: Resuspend each well in 10 µL 0.2 % FA, measure concentration on a Nanodrop, dilute to 0.5 µg µL⁻¹, then bottle the samples for LC‑MS analysis.

steps.title: Prepare ratio‑check samples
steps.instruction: Create ratio‑check tubes containing a total of 10 µg peptide; allocate equal peptide amounts per TMT channel (e.g., 0.9 µg per channel for an 11‑plex) and, if using a bridge channel, add 20 µg.

steps.title: Data analysis and ratio adjustment
steps.instruction: Process raw files with Proteome Discoverer 2.2, calculate channel ratios using PSM quant values, adjust each channel to a 1:1 ratio, compile the corrected sample set, and re‑run on the mass spectrometer.
